result.brief: 提出语义差异对齐损失，对齐视觉与文本表征变化方向，并构建 VarFamily-40K 受控变化数据集，提升细粒度视觉表征与组合理解。
result.reason: Proposes a semantic-difference alignment loss aligning visual and textual representation change directions, improving fine-grained visual representations—directly a representation-alignment contribution.
